field.entropyQualification: field-cardinality ceiling only; not a complete protocol soundness or QROM bound

encoding.raw: canonical fixed-width big-endian coefficients, least-degree coefficient first

parameterAvailability: Pinned p3-bn254 exports a Poseidon2 type and round-count constants but no reviewed default-constant constructor, so permutation benchmarking stops rather than inventing constants.
compatibility: Pinned p3-bn254 implements Field and TwoAdicField, so generic p3-dft/p3-fri arithmetic interfaces are available. A complete hash/MMCS/transcript/PCS instantiation is not frozen.
fieldSpecificAttackReview: Large-prime arithmetic avoids extension subfields but does not remove Fiat-Shamir, FRI, grinding, hiding, or QROM obligations. Canonical 254-bit decoding is mandatory.
implementationMaturity: MEDIUM_FIELD_LOW_STACK: pinned scalar arithmetic exists; no frozen PQTornado application permutation, PCS, Solidity codec, or complete proof uses this field.

gate.reason: No candidate may pass on microbench and byte floors alone; complete proof bytes, total EVM gas, prover time, soundness, and maturity are not all evidenced.
